args.query:
// Country-level co-driver network density and frequency summary
MATCH (a:Substance)-[r1:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(s:Site)
MATCH (b:Substance)-[r2:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(s)
WHERE a.DTXSID < b.DTXSID AND r1.species = r2.species AND r1.time_point = r2.time_point
WITH s.country AS country, a.DTXSID AS id1, b.DTXSID AS id2, count(*) AS pair_freq
WITH country, id1, id2, pair_freq
ORDER BY country, pair_freq DESC
WITH country, collect({id1:id1, id2:id2, freq:pair_freq}) AS pairs
// count nodes (unique driver substances per country)
MATCH (x:Substance)-[rx:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(sx:Site)
WITH country, pairs, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sx.country = country THEN x.DTXSID END) AS nodes_raw
WITH country, pairs, [n IN nodes_raw WHERE n IS NOT NULL] AS nodes
WITH country, size(nodes) AS n_substances,
     size(pairs) AS n_edges,
     CASE WHEN size(nodes) > 1 THEN toFloat(size(pairs)) / (size(nodes)*(size(nodes)-1)/2) ELSE 0 END AS edge_density,
     CASE WHEN size(pairs) > 0 THEN toFloat(reduce(sumf=0, p IN pairs | sumf + p.freq)) / size(pairs) ELSE 0 END AS mean_edge_freq,
     CASE WHEN size(pairs) > 0 THEN reduce(mx=0, p IN pairs | CASE WHEN p.freq > mx THEN p.freq ELSE mx END) ELSE 0 END AS max_edge_freq
RETURN country, n_substances, n_edges, round(edge_density,4) AS edge_density, round(mean_edge_freq,2) AS mean_edge_freq, max_edge_freq
ORDER BY edge_density DESC, mean_edge_freq DESC
LIMIT 15

// Country-level co-driver network density and frequency (from IS_DRIVER pairs per site/species/time)
MATCH (a:Substance)-[r:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(s:Site)
WITH s.country AS country, r.species AS species, r.time_point AS tp, collect(DISTINCT a.DTXSID) AS subs
WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND size(subs) >= 2
UNWIND range(0, size(subs)-2) AS i
UNWIND range(i+1, size(subs)-1) AS j
WITH country,
     CASE WHEN subs[i] < subs[j] THEN subs[i] ELSE subs[j] END AS id1,
     CASE WHEN subs[i] < subs[j] THEN subs[j] ELSE subs[i] END AS id2
WITH country, id1, id2, count(*) AS freq
WITH country, collect({id1:id1, id2:id2, freq:freq}) AS edges
MATCH (x:Substance)-[rx:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(sx:Site)
WHERE sx.country = country
WITH country, edges, collect(DISTINCT x.DTXSID) AS nodes
WITH country, nodes, edges,
     size(nodes) AS n_nodes,
     size(edges) AS n_edges,
     CASE WHEN size(nodes)>1 THEN toFloat(size(edges)) / (size(nodes)*(size(nodes)-1)/2) ELSE 0 END AS edge_density,
     CASE WHEN size(edges)>0 THEN round( reduce(s=0, e IN edges | s + e.freq) / toFloat(size(edges)), 2) ELSE 0 END AS mean_edge_freq,
     CASE WHEN size(edges)>0 THEN reduce(m=0, e IN edges | CASE WHEN e.freq > m THEN e.freq ELSE m END) ELSE 0 END AS max_edge_freq
RETURN country, n_nodes AS n_substances, n_edges, round(edge_density,4) AS edge_density, mean_edge_freq, max_edge_freq
ORDER BY edge_density DESC, mean_edge_freq DESC
LIMIT 15

// River-basin-level co-driver network density and frequency (from IS_DRIVER pairs per site/species/time)
MATCH (a:Substance)-[r:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(s:Site)
WITH s.river_basin AS basin, r.species AS species, r.time_point AS tp, collect(DISTINCT a.DTXSID) AS subs
WHERE basin IS NOT NULL AND size(subs) >= 2
UNWIND range(0, size(subs)-2) AS i
UNWIND range(i+1, size(subs)-1) AS j
WITH basin,
     CASE WHEN subs[i] < subs[j] THEN subs[i] ELSE subs[j] END AS id1,
     CASE WHEN subs[i] < subs[j] THEN subs[j] ELSE subs[i] END AS id2
WITH basin, id1, id2, count(*) AS freq
WITH basin, collect({id1:id1, id2:id2, freq:freq}) AS edges
MATCH (x:Substance)-[rx:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]->(sx:Site)
WHERE sx.river_basin = basin
WITH basin, edges, collect(DISTINCT x.DTXSID) AS nodes
WITH basin, nodes, edges,
     size(nodes) AS n_nodes,
     size(edges) AS n_edges,
     CASE WHEN size(nodes)>1 THEN toFloat(size(edges)) / (size(nodes)*(size(nodes)-1)/2) ELSE 0 END AS edge_density,
     CASE WHEN size(edges)>0 THEN round( reduce(s=0, e IN edges | s + e.freq) / toFloat(size(edges)), 2) ELSE 0 END AS mean_edge_freq,
     CASE WHEN size(edges)>0 THEN reduce(m=0, e IN edges | CASE WHEN e.freq > m THEN e.freq ELSE m END) ELSE 0 END AS max_edge_freq
RETURN basin AS river_basin, n_nodes AS n_substances, n_edges, round(edge_density,4) AS edge_density, mean_edge_freq, max_edge_freq
ORDER BY edge_density DESC, mean_edge_freq DESC
LIMIT 15

// Country-level driver co-network density using JOINT_DRIVER_WITH among substances that are drivers in that country
MATCH (site:Site)<-[r:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]-(a:Substance)
WITH site.country AS country, collect(DISTINCT a) AS subs
WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND size(subs) >= 2
WITH country, subs, size(subs) AS n_nodes
UNWIND range(0, n_nodes-2) AS i
UNWIND range(i+1, n_nodes-1) AS j
WITH country, n_nodes, subs[i] AS s1, subs[j] AS s2
MATCH (s1)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(s2)
WITH country, n_nodes, collect(j.frequency) AS freqs, count(*) AS n_edges
WITH country, n_nodes, n_edges,
     CASE WHEN n_nodes>1 THEN toFloat(n_edges)/(n_nodes*(n_nodes-1)/2) ELSE 0 END AS edge_density,
     CASE WHEN n_edges>0 THEN round(reduce(m=0.0,f IN freqs|m+f)/toFloat(n_edges),2) ELSE 0 END AS mean_edge_freq,
     CASE WHEN n_edges>0 THEN reduce(mx=0,f IN freqs | CASE WHEN f>mx THEN f ELSE mx END) ELSE 0 END AS max_edge_freq
RETURN country, n_nodes AS n_substances, n_edges, round(edge_density,4) AS edge_density, mean_edge_freq, max_edge_freq
ORDER BY edge_density DESC, mean_edge_freq DESC
LIMIT 15

// River-basin-level driver co-network density using JOINT_DRIVER_WITH among substances that are drivers in that basin
MATCH (site:Site)<-[r:IS_DRIVER {is_driver:true}]-(a:Substance)
WITH site.river_basin AS basin, collect(DISTINCT a) AS subs
WHERE basin IS NOT NULL AND size(subs) >= 2
WITH basin, subs, size(subs) AS n_nodes
UNWIND range(0, n_nodes-2) AS i
UNWIND range(i+1, n_nodes-1) AS j
WITH basin, n_nodes, subs[i] AS s1, subs[j] AS s2
MATCH (s1)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(s2)
WITH basin, n_nodes, collect(j.frequency) AS freqs, count(*) AS n_edges
WITH basin, n_nodes, n_edges,
     CASE WHEN n_nodes>1 THEN toFloat(n_edges)/(n_nodes*(n_nodes-1)/2) ELSE 0 END AS edge_density,
     CASE WHEN n_edges>0 THEN round(reduce(m=0.0,f IN freqs|m+f)/toFloat(n_edges),2) ELSE 0 END AS mean_edge_freq,
     CASE WHEN n_edges>0 THEN reduce(mx=0,f IN freqs | CASE WHEN f>mx THEN f ELSE mx END) ELSE 0 END AS max_edge_freq
RETURN basin AS river_basin, n_nodes AS n_substances, n_edges, round(edge_density,4) AS edge_density, mean_edge_freq, max_edge_freq
ORDER BY edge_density DESC, mean_edge_freq DESC
LIMIT 15

Note: Edges and their frequencies are taken from the global JOINT_DRIVER_WITH network; I induced country/basin-specific subgraphs by selecting substances that act as drivers in that country/basin. This does not restrict co-driver frequencies to within that country/basin.
